mapper.insert: INSERT INTO business_settings ( business_id, booking_interval, auto_confirm, allow_online_booking, max_advance_booking_days, min_advance_booking_hours, send_confirmation_sms, send_reminder_sms, reminder_hours_before, send_cancel_sms, kakao_channel_id, kakao_api_key, kakao_enabled, payment_methods, require_deposit, deposit_amount, allow_cancellation, cancel_deadline_hours, no_show_penalty_enabled, timezone, language ) VALUES ( #{businessId}, #{bookingInterval}, #{autoConfirm}, #{allowOnlineBooking}, #{maxAdvanceBookingDays}, #{minAdvanceBookingHours}, #{sendConfirmationSms}, #{sendReminderSms}, #{reminderHoursBefore}, #{sendCancelSms}, #{kakaoChannelId}, #{kakaoApiKey}, #{kakaoEnabled}, #{paymentMethods}, #{requireDeposit}, #{depositAmount}, #{allowCancellation}, #{cancelDeadlineHours}, #{noShowPenaltyEnabled}, #{timezone}, #{language} )
